resources.string: Welcome to Bejaia, a historic coastal city steeped in rich heritage and timeless beauty. Explore ancient landmarks, legendary tales, and breathtaking landscapes that have shaped its unique identity. Let our guide lead you through the captivating past of this remarkable city.

The most beautiful beaches of Béjaïa
Discover Béjaïa Where History Meets Coastal Charm

Nestled between the sparkling Mediterranean and the lush slopes of Mount Gouraya, Béjaïa is a vibrant blend of ancient tales and natural wonders. Wander through layers of history—from Roman ruins and a mighty Spanish fortress to Ottoman mosques—while soaking in panoramic views of a bay once ruled by Barbary pirates. Stroll the bustling port, where Saharan oil meets modern trade, or unwind on golden Aiguades Beach with the iconic Monkey Peak towering above, home to playful Barbary macaques. Dive into Kabylia’s rich Berber culture, savor local olive oil and wine, and explore Gouraya National Park’s trails for sunset vistas. With its mix of rugged landscapes, centuries-old secrets, and lively markets, Béjaïa invites you to uncover Algeria’s hidden gem—one adventure at a time. 🌊⛰️✨
